resources.string: Send and receive UDP packets from within ATAK
Not a valid CoT address. Use host or host:port, e.g. 255.255.255.255 or 239.2.3.1:6969.
This device only - nothing sent to the network
Broadcast to %1$s:%2$d - every ATAK on this link
Broadcast on port %1$d - link is down, subnet unknown
Multicast %1$s:%2$d - every ATAK joined to this group
%1$s is not on this link (%2$s) - it will not arrive

BLANK
This device only. Nothing is sent.

255.255.255.255 (default)
Everyone on current network. Sent to the local broadcast address for whichever link is selected above.

239.2.3.1:6969
The ATAK multicast group.

192.168.1.50:4242
One specific device or TAK server.

PORT
Defaults to 4242. The receiving ATAK must have a UDP input on the port you choose, the mesh group needs 6969.
%1$d radio(s) are enrolled by UID, which only works over a tethered link. Re-add them by their wifi IP address.
Stop polling %1$s (%2$s) and remove it from the list? Its marker will be removed from the map.
